push.lead: Fans call Djokovic the king of the return, yet on the ATP's official all-time Return Rating he is only No. 7. A 200 km/h serve reaches the returner in about 0.6–0.7 s, and a simple human reaction takes about 0.2 s. Elite returners take off as the server strikes, land 0.15 s later and start the racket at 0.19 s: they guess before they see the ball clearly. Djokovic is No. 7 all-time, No. 2 on hard courts, No. 1 among active players, and hits the deepest returns.
